{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → `uExportImport`
{{% /callout %}}

Moves a model between Tekla versions through an XML file: export it here, then open a new, empty model in the other version and import the same file there.

**How to use:**

1.  Export: choose the file, optionally tick *Selected objects only*, and press *Export*. A selection also takes what it hangs on.
2.  Import: open a new, empty model in the target version, choose the same file and press *Import*. *Import UDAs* controls whether user-defined attributes are read back.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
Import adds everything in the file to the open model, so importing into a model that already has the objects creates them twice.
{{% /callout %}}

Carried across: parts and items, cuts, fittings, bolts, welds, surface treatments, grids, reinforcement and rebar sets. Reinforcement whose part cannot be rebuilt gets a DUMMY part instead. *Stop* cancels a running export or import.
